items.title: Enrichment of Repeat Expansions in FGF14 Associated with Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis
items.abstract_or_text: Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) is a neurodegenerative disease characterised by progressive motor neuron loss and corticospinal tract degeneration. The genetic landscape of ALS is complex, with increasing recognition of shared genetic and phenotypic features with other neurodegenerative conditions, particularly those involving repeat expansions. Given that repeat expansions in disorders like spinocerebellar ataxia type 27B (SCA27B), caused by an intronic GAA repeat expansion in Fibroblast Growth Factor 14 (FGF14), are recognised to extend beyond cerebellar ataxia with frequent pyramidal signs, we hypothesised that FGF14 repeat expansions might also contribute to ALS and degeneration of corticospinal pathways, and sought to investigate whether repeat length is associated with clinical phenotype. We screened 62 individuals with ALS using PacBio HiFi long-read whole-genome sequencing and compared repeat-size distributions with 256 healthy controls from the Human Pangenome Reference Consortium. Repeat expansions were confirmed using flanking PCR and repeat-primed PCR. We identified pathogenic-range FGF14 GAA [≥]250 expansions, the established threshold for SCA27B, in 3/62 ALS cases (4.8%) and none in controls. Further analysis revealed that GAA expansions [≥]200 repeats were enriched in ALS compared to controls (8.1% vs 0.4%; p = 0.0013), suggesting a broader pathogenic spectrum for FGF14 GAA repeats in ALS. In contrast, GAAGGA expansions were not significantly associated. Expanded pure GAA alleles were predicted to form triplex (H-DNA) structures, with the repeat-containing isoform (1B) being the predominant FGF14 transcript in motor neurons. These findings demonstrate that FGF14 GAA repeat expansions extend into the motor neuron disease spectrum.
items.summary_zh: 对62例 ALS 进行 PacBio HiFi 长读长全基因组测序，并与256名 HPRC 健康对照比较 FGF14 GAA 重复扩增。
items.why_it_matters_zh: FGF14 GAA≥200 重复在 ALS 病例中富集（8.1% 对 0.4%，p=0.0013），提出了运动神经元疾病相关遗传谱扩展的关联线索；样本量有限，尚不能证明致病性。
items.abstract_zh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种神经退行性疾病，以进行性运动神经元丧失和皮质脊髓束变性为特征。ALS 的遗传图景复杂，人们日益认识到其与其他神经退行性疾病存在共有的遗传和表型特征，尤其是涉及重复扩增的疾病。已知在脊髓小脑性共济失调27B型（SCA27B）等疾病中，Fibroblast Growth Factor 14（FGF14）内含子 GAA 重复扩增可引起的表型常见锥体束体征，且超出小脑性共济失调范围；因此，我们假设 FGF14 重复扩增也可能参与 ALS 和皮质脊髓通路变性，并探究重复长度是否与临床表型相关。我们使用 PacBio HiFi 长读长全基因组测序筛查62名 ALS 个体，并与来自 Human Pangenome Reference Consortium 的256名健康对照比较重复长度分布。重复扩增通过侧翼 PCR 和重复引物 PCR 得到确认。我们在3/62例 ALS 病例（4.8%）中识别出致病范围的 FGF14 GAA≥250 扩增——这是 SCA27B 已确立的阈值——而对照中未发现。进一步分析显示，与对照相比，ALS 中 GAA≥200 重复的扩增富集（8.1% 对 0.4%；p=0.0013），提示 FGF14 GAA 重复可能具有更广泛的 ALS 致病谱。相反，GAAGGA 扩增未呈现显著关联。预测扩增的纯 GAA 等位基因可形成三链（H-DNA）结构，且含重复序列的异构体（1B）是运动神经元中主要的 FGF14 转录本。这些发现显示 FGF14 GAA 重复扩增延伸至运动神经元疾病谱系。

items.title: Improvement of Gemcitabine Treatment of Pancreatic Cancer by the Addition of All-trans Retinoic Acid and Identification of Vitamin A and Pentraxin 3 as Potential Response Biomarkers
items.abstract_or_text: BackgroundTherapy resistance in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is facilitated by the desmoplastic tumor microenvironment (TME) orchestrated by cancer associated fibroblasts (CAFs). Upon activation, pancreatic stellate cells (PSCs) deplete their intracellular retinoic acid (RA)-containing lipid droplets and secrete stromal remodeling proteins like pentraxin 3 (PTX3), leading to cancer progression. Preclinical evidence indicates that all-trans RA (ATRA) reprograms the TME, while circulating vitamin A and PTX3 were proposed as biomarkers for ATRA response in PDAC. To support further clinical development of RA-based therapies in PDAC, we studied the effects of ATRA on CAFs and patient-derived organoids (PDO) and evaluated the clinical relevance of these biomarkers in PDAC patients. MethodsWe employed viability assays in human and murine organoid mono-and co-culture models to explore the efficacy of adding ATRA to gemcitabine (GEM). In parallel, we conducted a prospective observational study and assessed vitamin A and PTX3 as response biomarkers in peripheral blood collected before first treatment and at cycles 2 and 4 of treatment among patients with advanced PDAC receiving GEM with or without nab-paclitaxel (NAB-P). ResultsIn PDO monocultures, a significant additive effect of ATRA in combination with GEM on viability was observed in 5 (41%) of 12 PDOs and this effect was numerically more frequent in organoids from patients who had clinically responded to GEM. In human and murine 3D PDO+PSC/CAF co-cultures, ATRA demonstrated an additional direct impact on the viability of stromal cells. Clinically, among 18 patients with PDAC treated with GEM+/-NAB-P, patients with no treatment response (n=10) showed an increase in PTX3 and concomitant decrease in vitamin A levels under therapy. In contrast, response was associated with stable vitamin A levels and a trend towards lower PTX3 levels during chemotherapy. ConclusionsOur preclinical data support the repurposing of ATRA, an agent with favorable toxicity profile, to potentiate the efficacy of GEM in PDAC treatment. Complementing these results, our clinical data suggest vitamin A and PTX3 as promising response biomarkers in PDAC treatment, not restricted to ATRA containing regimens.
items.summary_zh: 在 PDAC 患者来源类器官与 CAF/PSC 共培养中考察 ATRA 加用 GEM，并在18例接受 GEM±NAB-P 患者中观察 vitamin A 与 PTX3 动态。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 类器官、基质细胞和小型前瞻性观察队列提供相互补充的早期证据；ATRA 增效及 vitamin A/PTX3 预测价值仍有待更大临床研究确认。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）的治疗耐药由癌症相关成纤维细胞（CAFs）组织的促结缔组织增生性肿瘤微环境（TME）所促进。胰腺星状细胞（PSCs）激活后会耗竭其含视黄酸（RA）的胞内脂滴，并分泌如 pentraxin 3（PTX3）等基质重塑蛋白，从而促进癌症进展。临床前证据表明，全反式 RA（ATRA）可重编程 TME，而循环 vitamin A 和 PTX3 被提出作为 PDAC 中 ATRA 反应的生物标志物。为支持 PDAC 中 RA 类治疗的进一步临床开发，我们研究了 ATRA 对 CAFs 和患者来源类器官（PDO）的作用，并评价这些生物标志物在 PDAC 患者中的临床相关性。方法：我们在人体和小鼠类器官单培养及共培养模型中采用活性测定，探索向 gemcitabine（GEM）中加入 ATRA 的疗效。同时，我们开展前瞻性观察研究，在接受 GEM 伴或不伴 nab-paclitaxel（NAB-P）治疗的晚期 PDAC 患者中，对首次治疗前以及治疗第2和第4周期采集的外周血中的 vitamin A 和 PTX3 作为反应生物标志物进行评价。结果：在 PDO 单培养中，12个 PDO 中有5个（41%）观察到 ATRA 联合 GEM 对活性的显著叠加效应；来自临床上对 GEM 有反应患者的类器官中，这一效应出现频率在数值上更高。在人体和小鼠三维 PDO+PSC/CAF 共培养中，ATRA 对基质细胞活性显示出额外的直接影响。在临床方面，在接受 GEM±NAB-P 治疗的18名 PDAC 患者中，无治疗反应患者（n=10）在治疗期间表现为 PTX3 升高并伴随 vitamin A 水平降低。相反，有反应与化疗期间 vitamin A 水平稳定及 PTX3 水平趋向降低相关。结论：我们的临床前数据支持将具有良好毒性特征的 ATRA 再利用，以增强 GEM 治疗 PDAC 的疗效。作为补充，临床数据提示 vitamin A 和 PTX3 是 PDAC 治疗中有前景的反应生物标志物，其应用不局限于包含 ATRA 的方案。

items.title: Grading the Graders: Verification Autonomy Levels (L0-L5) for LLM Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly paired with verifiers (step checkers, self-consistency filters, tool-based fact checkers, formal proof assistants) that claim to detect the model's errors. Yet the verification literature uses the word "level" to mean at least five different things: verification granularity, concept abstraction, risk tier, system-stack layer, and the epistemic source of the ground truth. We propose Verification Autonomy Levels (VAL), a meta-standard classifying verification schemes along a single axis: where does the verification spec come from, and what does the verdict guarantee? VAL ranges from L0 (LLM self-declaration, no deterministic anchor) through L2 (objective ground truth, correctness only) to L3/L4 (decidable systems with single-property or domain-level completeness), with L5 impossible in the unrestricted case. Central to VAL is the completeness blind spot: substitution- and sampling-based verifiers can confirm that proposed candidates hold, but cannot prove that no candidate was missed. We further identify a dichotomy the literature has not stated: completeness is reachable only for formally specifiable properties, while empirical open-world verification (fact-checking, diagnosis) caps at anchored correctness (L2). We document this across four domains (symbolic mathematics, behavior monitoring, medical diagnosis, and code generation) and in the strongest existing formal-verification baseline, whose authors note the verifier "focuses on the correctness of each step." We show the levels of granularity, concept hierarchy, risk, and system stack are orthogonal to VAL, resolving a systematic conflation across 17 surveyed papers. Code and full assessment are released as supplementary material.
items.summary_zh: 提出 Verification Autonomy Levels（VAL）框架，以验证规格的来源和结论可保证的性质来区分 LLM 推理验证方案，并指出形式化可描述性质与开放世界经验任务在完备性上存在根本差异。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它将“验证”中常被混用的概念拆开讨论，并明确形式化证明助手、步骤检查和事实核查分别能给出何种保证；这有助于避免把局部正确性误作完整证明。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）日益与验证器配合使用，包括步骤检查器、自一致性过滤器、基于工具的事实检查器和形式化证明助手；这些验证器都声称能够发现模型的错误。然而，验证文献中的“级别”一词至少有五种不同含义：验证粒度、概念抽象程度、风险等级、系统栈层次以及真实依据的认识论来源。我们提出 Verification Autonomy Levels（VAL），这是一项元标准，沿单一轴线分类验证方案：验证规格来自何处，以及判定结果能够保证什么。VAL 从 L0（LLM 自我声明，没有确定性依据），经由 L2（客观真实依据，仅保证正确性），到 L3/L4（具有单一性质或领域级完备性的可判定系统）；在无约束情形下，L5 不可能实现。VAL 的核心是完备性盲区：基于替换和采样的验证器能够确认给出的候选项成立，却无法证明没有遗漏任何候选项。我们还识别出文献尚未明确表述的一项二分：完备性仅可在可形式化规定的性质上实现，而经验性的开放世界验证（事实核查、诊断）至多达到有依据的正确性（L2）。我们在四个领域中记录这一点：符号数学、行为监控、医疗诊断和代码生成；也在现有最强的形式化验证基线中记录这一点，其作者指出该验证器“关注每一步的正确性”。我们表明，粒度、概念层级、风险和系统栈均与 VAL 正交，从而澄清了对 17 篇受调查论文中系统性混淆的概念。代码和完整评估作为补充材料发布。
items.author_line: Yajie Yin

items.title: Preference Reasoning under Indeterminacy in Large Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: As large language models evolve into decision-making agents, the ability to reason over preferences becomes fundamental to alignment, coordination, and collective intelligence. Yet, unlike standard benchmarks, real-world preference reasoning is inherently indeterminate: information may be incomplete, and valid solutions may not exist. We argue that indeterminacy, rather than correctness alone, is a central challenge for AI reasoning. We formalize this challenge along two axes, (i) epistemic indeterminacy, arising from incomplete, partial, or expressive preferences, and (ii) structural indeterminacy, arising from the non-existence of solutions under standard social choice concepts. Across a hierarchy of tasks, we show that state-of-the-art language models systematically fail to distinguish between determined and undetermined instances, exhibiting miscalibrated reasoning even in verification settings.
items.summary_zh: 将 LLM 的偏好推理问题形式化为认识论不确定性与结构性不确定性两条轴，并报告当前模型常不能区分存在确定解和不存在确定解的实例。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 对社会选择与多主体决策而言，能识别信息不足或解不存在，比强行给出偏好排序更可检验；论文将这一点转化为可评测的推理任务。
items.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型演变为决策智能体，对偏好进行推理的能力成为对齐、协调和集体智能的基础。然而，与标准基准不同，现实世界的偏好推理天然具有不确定性：信息可能不完整，且有效解可能不存在。我们认为，相对于仅关注正确性，不确定性是 AI 推理中的核心挑战。我们沿两条轴线形式化这一挑战：（i）认识论不确定性，源于不完整、部分或表达能力受限的偏好；（ii）结构性不确定性，源于标准社会选择概念下解的不存在。在一组层级化任务中，我们表明，当前最先进的语言模型系统性地无法区分确定与不确定实例，即使在验证设置中也表现出校准失当的推理。
items.author_line: Hadi Hosseini, Samarth Khanna, Xiyuan Wang

items.title: Structure-Internalized Rule Language Model for Faithful Knowledge Graph Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Knowledge Graph Reasoning (KGR) aims to discover latent facts by leveraging the structural evidence available in KGs, posing a challenge to the structural semantic understanding capability of KGR models. Recent studies have demonstrated that Large Language Models (LLMs) can achieve remarkable progress on KGR tasks via flexible in-context learning. However, the inherent representation inconsistency between KG structural context and LLM parametric knowledge remains inadequately addressed. This limitation prevents LLMs from effectively perceiving reasoning evidence that aligns with KG constraints, which undermines both the effectiveness and faithfulness of reasoning. We refer to this problem as reasoning evidence perception drift of LLMs over KGs. To address this problem, we propose a Structure-Internalized Rule Language Model (SIRLM), which centers on structural rule generation to couple the parametric learning of structural knowledge with the faithfulness evaluation of reasoning logic, enabling LLMs to anchor tightly to KG-grounded evidence. Specifically, we first design a Structure-Internalized Rule Generator (SIRG), which incorporates an in-context learning block augmented with a structural relation memory to coordinate structural and parametric knowledge. Furthermore, we equip SIRG with a KG tokenizer based on structural invariance learning and a neuro-symbolic reasoner based on rule-constrained message propagation. These components provide SIRG with learnable structural representations and faithful rule-execution feedback, respectively. Our SIRLM can be seamlessly integrated into standard LLM training paradigms, such as SFT and GRPO. Extensive experiments against 17 state-of-the-art KGR methods on 36 datasets demonstrate the significant superiority of SIRLM.
items.summary_zh: SIRLM 为知识图谱推理生成结构规则，并结合结构关系记忆、知识图谱 tokenizer 和受规则约束的神经符号推理器；作者在 36 个数据集上与 17 种 KGR 方法比较。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作关注模型答案能否由知识图谱结构证据支撑，且给出了跨数据集比较；文中的优越性结论仍属于预印本作者报告。
items.abstract_zh: 知识图谱推理（KGR）旨在利用知识图谱中可获得的结构证据发现潜在事实，这对 KGR 模型的结构语义理解能力提出挑战。近期研究已表明，大语言模型（LLM）能够借助灵活的上下文学习在 KGR 任务上取得显著进展。然而，知识图谱结构语境与 LLM 参数知识之间固有的表征不一致仍未得到充分处理。这一局限使 LLM 难以有效感知符合知识图谱约束的推理证据，从而削弱推理的有效性和忠实性。我们将这一问题称为 LLM 在知识图谱上的推理证据感知漂移。为解决这一问题，我们提出 Structure-Internalized Rule Language Model（SIRLM）。该模型以结构规则生成为中心，将结构知识的参数学习与推理逻辑的忠实性评估结合，使 LLM 能够紧密依据知识图谱支撑的证据。具体而言，我们首先设计 Structure-Internalized Rule Generator（SIRG），其将由结构关系记忆增强的上下文学习模块纳入其中，以协调结构知识和参数知识。此外，我们为 SIRG 配备基于结构不变性学习的知识图谱 tokenizer，以及基于规则约束消息传播的神经符号推理器。这些组件分别为 SIRG 提供可学习的结构表征和忠实的规则执行反馈。SIRLM 可无缝整合到标准 LLM 训练范式中，如 SFT 和 GRPO。针对 36 个数据集上的 17 种当前最先进 KGR 方法开展的大量实验表明，SIRLM 具有显著优越性。
items.author_line: Xingrui Zhuo, Jiapu Wang, Manzong Huang, Gongqing Wu, Xindong Wu

items.title: Training-Free Inference-Time Self-Reflection and Cost-Bounded Early Stopping for Large Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Reinforcement-learning training of reasoning LLMs (e.g., GRPO) is expensive and requires a controllable environment, committing every contribution to a full training pipeline. We present EvoResearcher, a training-free, inference-time protocol that adds cost-bounded self-reflection to a single frozen LLM backbone. The protocol iterates generate -> self-critique -> revise until a maximum depth D is reached or the critique returns the CONFIRMED sentinel, an implicit early stop that lets the backbone self-verify its answer under a strict compute budget. Four self-reflective meta-reward components (correctness, efficiency, reflection depth, tool-call diversity) act as design principles instantiated as prompt-level mechanisms, so their benefits accrue with zero gradient updates. We validate the protocol on Big-Bench Hard (100 questions) and establish cross-domain behavior on GSM8K (500) and MATH (500) on the same frozen backbone, with cross-model replication on Qwen2.5-72B. All experiments use pure-reasoning benchmarks; the tool-call diversity component is validated in prompt-level form, and the environment-level and multi-agent extensions are design blueprints left to future work. On clean BBH the protocol does not raise accuracy beyond the 95% Wilson interval; its value is cost-bounded self-verification, with the CONFIRMED early stop terminating 82-88% of items at equal accuracy (about 2.1 generations per question).
items.summary_zh: EvoResearcher 在冻结的 LLM 上迭代生成、自我批评和修订，并以 CONFIRMED 作为计算受限条件下的提前终止信号；在 BBH、GSM8K 和 MATH 上评测时，作者报告准确率未超过 95% Wilson 区间。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 论文没有把自我反思描述成普遍的准确率提升，而把其结果限定为相同准确率下减少生成次数；这种报告方式较便于判断推理流程的实际作用。
items.abstract_zh: 对推理型 LLM 进行强化学习训练（如 GRPO）成本高昂，并且需要可控环境，使得每一项改进都要投入完整训练流程。我们提出 EvoResearcher，这是一种无需训练、在推理时运行的协议，为单个冻结的 LLM 主干加入计算受限的自我反思。该协议迭代执行生成→自我批评→修订，直至达到最大深度 D，或批评返回 CONFIRMED 标记。后者是一种隐式提前终止方式，使主干模型在严格计算预算内自行验证答案。四个自我反思元奖励成分（正确性、效率、反思深度、工具调用多样性）作为通过提示机制实现的设计原则，因此无需梯度更新即可获得其效果。我们在 Big-Bench Hard（100 个问题）上验证该协议，并在同一冻结主干上的 GSM8K（500 个）和 MATH（500 个）上建立跨领域表现，且在 Qwen2.5-72B 上进行跨模型复现。全部实验使用纯推理基准；工具调用多样性成分以提示层面的形式验证，环境层面和多智能体扩展仍是留待未来工作的设计蓝图。在干净的 BBH 上，该协议未将准确率提升至 95% Wilson 区间之外；其价值在于计算受限的自我验证，CONFIRMED 提前终止以相同准确率结束了 82% 至 88% 的题目，约为每题 2.1 次生成。
items.author_line: Wei Yu, Suxing Liu, Minjie Yu, Jiahao Wang, Zhijian Zheng, Haocheng Deng, Bing Li

items.title: Can a Lightweight Multimodal Model Estimate LLM Reasoning Performance? A Study for Compute-Optimal Document Inference
items.abstract_or_text: Uniformly allocating inference reasoning budgets to LLMs is expensive and prone to over-thinking penalties; especially in document tasks where visual layouts drive complexity. To address this, we introduce BudgetDoc, the first multimodal benchmark providing explicit supervision for model-budget-performance trade-offs across three document tasks. Using BudgetDoc, we train DRB (Document-Reasoning Balancer), an approx. 1B-parameter pre-flight estimator (SigLIP-2 + Qwen3-0.6B) that predicts ordinal model performance across budget levels, achieving a 0.753 weighted F1. When dynamically allocating reasoning budgets across five frontier models and three datasets, DRB matches or improves F1 scores compared to always-maximum-budget baselines in 9 of 15 configurations while drastically reducing cost. Finally, preliminary evaluations demonstrate DRB's potential to generalize to cross-model selection.
items.summary_zh: BudgetDoc 为三类文档任务提供模型、推理预算和性能之间关系的显式监督；约 10 亿参数的 DRB 预测预算档位下的模型表现，在动态分配预算的 15 种配置中有 9 种达到或超过始终使用最大预算的 F1。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究把“多想一会儿是否更好”变成可测量的预算分配问题。结果局限于文档任务与所报告的模型、数据集配置，不能外推为普遍推理能力结论。
items.abstract_zh: 对 LLM 一律分配相同的推理预算既昂贵，又容易产生过度思考惩罚；在视觉版式决定复杂度的文档任务中尤其如此。为解决这一问题，我们引入 BudgetDoc，这是首个为三类文档任务提供模型—预算—性能权衡显式监督的多模态基准。利用 BudgetDoc，我们训练 DRB（Document-Reasoning Balancer），这是一个约 10 亿参数的推理前估计器（SigLIP-2 + Qwen3-0.6B），可预测不同预算水平下模型表现的序数等级，取得 0.753 的加权 F1。在五个前沿模型和三个数据集上动态分配推理预算时，与始终使用最大预算的基线相比，DRB 在 15 种配置中的 9 种里达到相同或更高的 F1，同时显著降低计算开销。最后，初步评估显示 DRB 有望泛化到跨模型选择。
items.author_line: Zishan Ahmad, Vishal Vaddina

items.title: SignalReasoner: Assessing the Upper Bound of 3B Models for Signal Mathematical Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Post-training with supervised chain-of-thought fine-tuning and reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards has substantially improved the mathematical reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, their application to signal processing problems remains relatively under-explored. This report investigates reinforcement fine-tuning strategies for adapting Qwen2.5-3B-Base to graduate-level signal mathematical problems from WirelessMATHBench-XL, a comprehensive benchmark for mathematical reasoning in this domain. We examine two training paradigms: (i) direct reinforcement learning (RL) on WirelessMATHBench-XL with verifiable rewards; and (ii) supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on a distilled wireless-domain chain-of-thought corpus, followed by the same domain-specific RL stage. Across both paradigms, we benchmark Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO), and Geometric-Mean Policy Optimization (GMPO). We aim to assess whether domain-aware CoT SFT serves as an effective initialization for subsequent RL, and whether GSPO or GMPO offer advantages in stability or accuracy over GRPO for signal reasoning tasks. Our best model achieves an overall accuracy of 39.12\%, representing a more than threefold improvement over the untrained Base model (12.37\%).
items.summary_zh: 以 WirelessMATHBench-XL 的研究生层次信号数学题为对象，比较 Qwen2.5-3B-Base 的直接强化学习与先进行领域 CoT SFT 再强化学习两种路线，并比较 GRPO、GSPO 和 GMPO。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它给出小模型在专门信号数学任务上的明确基准、训练方案和准确率；39.12% 的最佳准确率也说明该任务距离可靠求解仍有明显差距。
items.abstract_zh: 通过监督式思维链微调和来自可验证奖励的强化学习进行后训练，已显著提高大语言模型（LLM）的数学推理能力。然而，它们在信号处理问题上的应用仍相对缺乏探索。本报告研究强化微调策略，以使 Qwen2.5-3B-Base 适应 WirelessMATHBench-XL 中的研究生层次信号数学问题；WirelessMATHBench-XL 是该领域一个综合性的数学推理基准。我们考察两种训练范式：（i）在具有可验证奖励的 WirelessMATHBench-XL 上直接进行强化学习（RL）；（ii）先在蒸馏得到的无线领域思维链语料上进行监督微调（SFT），再进入相同的领域特定 RL 阶段。在两种范式中，我们对 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）、Group Sequence Policy Optimization（GSPO）和 Geometric-Mean Policy Optimization（GMPO）进行基准比较。我们的目标是评估领域感知的 CoT SFT 是否能作为后续 RL 的有效初始化，以及在信号推理任务上，GSPO 或 GMPO 是否在稳定性或准确率方面优于 GRPO。最佳模型取得 39.12% 的总体准确率，相比未经训练的 Base 模型的 12.37%，提高超过三倍。
items.author_line: Guozheng Sun

items.title: What Aggregate Scores Miss: Measuring Item-Level Regressions in Commercial LLM API Migrations
items.abstract_or_text: Context: Software systems that depend on commercial large language model APIs must migrate to successor versions when vendors deprecate older models. Migration decisions typically rely on aggregate benchmark scores, which compress heterogeneous item-level behaviour into a single net figure. Objective: We measure what that compression conceals. Method: On three pairwise upgrades in the GPT-5.4 to GPT-5.6 Sol product sequence, we query 900 public benchmark items (graduate-level knowledge, olympiad mathematics, instruction following) 50 times per item per model, classify each item as reliably improved, reliably regressed, practically equivalent, or inconclusive under false-discovery-rate control and a practical-significance threshold, and calibrate the results against a label-permutation null. Results: Across all nine migration-benchmark cells, reliable improvements and reliable regressions coexist. Edges with aggregate gains of up to 7.3 percentage points contain up to 8.3% reliably regressed items; edges with aggregate losses contain up to 10.7% reliably improved items. On the instruction-following benchmark, the gap between strict and loose scoring widens by 3.9 percentage points on the latest migration: a 3.9-point regression under strict scoring shrinks to 0.04 points under loose scoring. Conclusion: Migration decisions based on aggregate scores alone miss substantial bidirectional item-level change. The complete response-level archive and per-item scoring outputs are released.
items.summary_zh: 对 GPT-5.4 至 GPT-5.6 Sol 的三次相邻 API 迁移，在研究生知识、奥数数学和指令遵循的 900 个公开基准题上重复采样，并按项目识别可靠进步、可靠退步、实用等价或结论不明。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 总分提升可能掩盖一部分题目的稳定退步。该工作提供项目级统计检验和完整响应档案，适合审视模型升级对数学题表现的实际影响。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：依赖商业大语言模型 API 的软件系统，在供应商废弃旧模型时必须迁移到后继版本。迁移决策通常依靠汇总基准分数，这会将异质的题目级行为压缩为一个净值。目标：我们测量这种压缩所掩盖的内容。方法：在 GPT-5.4 至 GPT-5.6 Sol 产品序列中的三次两两升级上，我们对 900 个公开基准题目（研究生层次知识、奥林匹克数学、指令遵循）中每个题目、每个模型查询 50 次；在错误发现率控制和实用显著性阈值下，将每个题目归为可靠进步、可靠退步、实用等价或结论不明，并以标签置换零假设校准结果。结果：在全部九个迁移—基准组合中，可靠进步和可靠退步同时存在。汇总分数最高提高 7.3 个百分点的迁移中，最多有 8.3% 的题目出现可靠退步；汇总分数下降的迁移中，最多有 10.7% 的题目出现可靠进步。在指令遵循基准上，最新迁移的严格评分与宽松评分之间的差距扩大 3.9 个百分点：严格评分下 3.9 个百分点的退步，在宽松评分下缩小为 0.04 个百分点。结论：仅根据汇总分数进行迁移决策，会遗漏大量双向的题目级变化。完整的响应级档案和逐题评分输出已发布。
items.author_line: Xiaonan Xu, Wenjing Wu

items.title: Quantum-Logic Tsetlin Machines: Interpretable Quantum Machine Learning with Commuting Projector Clauses
items.abstract_or_text: Tsetlin Machines (TMs) learn interpretable Boolean clauses using finite-state automata. We introduce the Quantum-Logic Tsetlin Machine (QL-TM), which replaces Boolean literals with quantum propositions represented by projectors while retaining classical include/exclude automata. Clauses are restricted to commuting measurement contexts and activate through the Born probability of their joint projector. We prove an exact reduction to ordinary Boolean TM clauses in diagonal computational-basis contexts and connect Pauli-projector clauses to stabilizer and syndrome semantics. Controlled experiments on Bell states, phase-flip syndromes, randomized 16-class stabilizer tasks, mixed literal pools, context-budget ablations, and finite-shot noise show that correct non-diagonal contexts recover physically meaningful clauses, while diagonal or wrong contexts lose the relevant phase/syndrome information. The context-budget results closely follow the predicted separability ladder 2^(b-k) as true stabilizer generators are removed. The contribution is a controlled bridge between Tsetlin clause learning and quantum logic, not a claim of quantum advantage.
items.summary_zh: Quantum-Logic Tsetlin Machine 以投影算符表示量子命题，以对易测量语境限制子句；论文证明它在对角计算基语境中可精确约化为普通 Boolean Tsetlin Machine 子句，并在受控量子任务上实验。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 精确约化为经典模型和多组受控实验，使量子逻辑子句的解释范围能够接受检验；作者明确未将其描述为量子优势。
items.abstract_zh: Tsetlin Machines（TM）使用有限状态自动机学习可解释的 Boolean 子句。我们引入 Quantum-Logic Tsetlin Machine（QL-TM），它以由投影算符表示的量子命题替代 Boolean 字面量，同时保留经典的纳入/排除自动机。子句被限制在对易测量语境中，并通过其联合投影算符的 Born 概率激活。我们证明，在对角计算基语境中，它可精确约化为普通 Boolean TM 子句，并将 Pauli 投影算符子句与稳定子和综合征语义联系起来。针对 Bell 态、相位翻转综合征、随机化的 16 类稳定子任务、混合字面量池、语境预算消融和有限采样噪声开展的受控实验表明，正确的非对角语境能够恢复具有物理意义的子句，而对角语境或错误语境会丢失相关的相位/综合征信息。随着移除真实稳定子生成元，语境预算结果紧密遵循预测的可分离性阶梯 2^(b-k)。该贡献是在 Tsetlin 子句学习与量子逻辑之间建立一个受控桥梁，并不宣称量子优势。
items.author_line: Krishna Bhatia

items.title: Policy-Invariant Reward Shaping from LLM Feedback: A Framework for Hybrid RL Agents
items.abstract_or_text: Combining large language models with reinforcement learning is increasingly explored, yet the theoretical status of LLM-derived reward signals is often left implicit. We formalize the hybrid LLM-planner and RL-controller architecture as a Goal-Augmented Markov Decision Process and show that when the LLM per-state progress score is used as a bounded potential function, the resulting shaping term preserves the optimal policy set even when the LLM scores are inaccurate. This guarantee is stronger than what general LLM-as-reward approaches provide. We verify the result numerically on a small MDP under four potential configurations, including an adversarial one scaled to twenty times the base reward magnitude.
items.summary_zh: 将 LLM 规划器与 RL 控制器表示为 Goal-Augmented Markov Decision Process，并证明只要把 LLM 的逐状态进度分数作为有界势函数，奖励塑形即使面对不准确分数也保持最优策略集合。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作给出混合 LLM-RL 奖励信号的条件性理论保证，并在含对抗性势函数的小型 MDP 中数值验证；保证范围取决于势函数有界等前提。
items.abstract_zh: 将大语言模型与强化学习结合正受到越来越多探索，但由 LLM 导出的奖励信号在理论上的地位常常未被明确说明。我们将混合 LLM 规划器和 RL 控制器架构形式化为 Goal-Augmented Markov Decision Process，并表明，当把 LLM 的逐状态进度分数用作有界势函数时，所得塑形项即使在 LLM 分数不准确时也保持最优策略集合。这一保证强于一般 LLM-as-reward 方法所提供的保证。我们在一个小型 MDP 上用四种势函数配置对该结果进行数值验证，其中包括一种尺度为基础奖励量级二十倍的对抗性配置。
items.author_line: Christophe D. Hounwanou, John Emeka Eze, Yaé U. Gaba

items.abstract_or_text: As models become more capable, the risks associated with developing and testing them internally also grow. We temporarily paused reinforcement learning (RL) training on our latest models intended for deployment for two weeks while we hardened and red-teamed our research environments and expanded monitoring coverage. Our largest planned frontier RL run remains on hold while smaller-scale training and evaluations validate these safeguards and establish more evidence of alignment.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布，为加强研究环境并扩大监测范围，已暂缓面向部署的最新模型强化学习训练两周；其最大规模的前沿强化学习训练仍待小规模训练和评测提供更多对齐证据。编辑认为，这是一项罕见且具体的前沿模型研发安全实践披露。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它将研发安全措施与实际训练排期直接关联，为讨论高能力模型的内部测试、监测覆盖与对齐证据提供了可参照的案例。
items.abstract_zh: 随着模型能力不断提升，在内部开发和测试它们所伴随的风险也在增长。我们暂时暂停了计划部署的最新模型的强化学习（RL）训练两周，以加固并红队测试我们的研究环境，并扩大监测覆盖范围。我们计划中规模最大的前沿强化学习训练仍处于暂停状态，等待较小规模的训练和评测验证这些保障措施，并建立更多对齐证据。
items.author_line: OpenAI

items.title: @NVIDIAAI：We benchmarked 300+ NVIDIA verified skills to see how much they actually help agents on real tasks. Same task, same mode
items.abstract_or_text: We benchmarked 300+ NVIDIA verified skills to see how much they actually help agents on real tasks. Same task, same model, same setup. The only difference was whether the agent had the skill. Across the benchmarks, skills improved correctness by 41 points, effectiveness by 39, and efficiency by 35. SkillEvaluator is open source if you want to test your own skills before you ship them.
items.summary_zh: NVIDIA 称，其在相同任务、模型和设置下测试了 300 多项已验证技能，仅改变代理是否获得该技能；发布方报告正确性、有效性和效率分别提高 41、39 和 35 个百分点，并开源了 SkillEvaluator。编辑认为，帖文提供了可复用的技能评测方向，但具体增益仍应结合基准任务和测量方法阅读。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 随着技能文件成为编程代理常用的上下文形式，针对其实际效果进行控制变量测试，有助于把经验性配置转化为可检验的工程选择。
items.abstract_zh: 我们对 300 多项经 NVIDIA 验证的技能进行了基准测试，以了解它们在真实任务中究竟能为代理带来多大帮助。相同的任务、相同的模型、相同的设置，唯一的区别是代理是否拥有该技能。综合这些基准，技能使正确性提高了 41 个百分点、有效性提高了 39 个百分点、效率提高了 35 个百分点。如果你想在发布自己的技能前测试它们，SkillEvaluator 已开源。

No intermediate ONNX export, and the resulting bundle can run through native C++ APIs. We also built the entire project with @OpenAIDevs Codex agents, with humans directing and reviewing the work. items.summary_zh: NVIDIA 发布 TensorRT Model Connect 公测版：受支持的 Hugging Face 模型可通过两条命令转换为端到端 TensorRT 推理流程，无需中间 ONNX 导出，并可由原生 C++ API 调用。发布方还称该开源项目在人工指导和审阅下广泛使用了 Codex 代理。编辑认为，其中可直接检查的实现、测试与文档比“由代理构建”的表述更值得工程团队关注。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工具尝试缩短模型从 Hugging Face 格式到 TensorRT 部署包之间的转换路径，并提供了可审查的开源工程实例。
items.abstract_zh: 我们刚刚发布了 TensorRT Model Connect 公测版。你可以只用两条命令，就把受支持的 Hugging Face 模型转换为端到端的 TensorRT 推理。无需中间的 ONNX 导出，生成的包可以通过原生 C++ API 运行。我们还在人工指导和审阅下，完全使用 OpenAI 的 Codex 代理构建了整个项目，其中包括模型实现、性能调优、测试、集成和文档。它是开源的，所以欢迎试用、查看实现，或为新模型贡献支持：

items.title: @pushmeet：Matrix multiplication is the basic computational operation that powers modern computing (including AI). Yet, the theoret
items.abstract_or_text: Matrix multiplication is the basic computational operation that powers modern computing (including AI). Yet, the theoretical fastest speed at which computers can multiply matrices (omega ω) is still unknown and has been a longstanding challenge for complexity theory and computer science. Today, we announce a new record for omega (ω<2.371177). This is the result of a great team effort between @GoogleDeepMind, our academic collaborators, and our Gemini-powered coding agent AlphaEvolve! 🧮
items.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 的 Pushmeet Kohli 宣布，团队与学术合作者及 Gemini 驱动的编程代理 AlphaEvolve 将矩阵乘法指数的已知上界推进到 ω<2.371177。作者将其定位为复杂性理论中的新纪录。编辑认为，这一结果展示了代理辅助程序搜索在理论计算机科学中的应用。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 矩阵乘法复杂度影响众多算法的理论效率；若相关构造和证明可被复核，代理参与发现过程的方式也将成为研究方法本身的重要讨论对象。
items.abstract_zh: 矩阵乘法是驱动现代计算（包括 AI）的基础计算操作。然而，计算机能够以多快的理论最快速度相乘矩阵（ω）仍未知，这是复杂性理论和计算机科学中长期存在的挑战。今天，我们宣布 ω 的一项新纪录（ω<2.371177）。这是 Google DeepMind、我们的学术合作者以及由 Gemini 驱动的编程代理 AlphaEvolve 共同努力的成果！🧮
items.author_line: Pushmeet Kohli

items.title: @DrJimFan：Seeing a hype wave around GEN-1.5, and rightfully so. Lots of respect to Pete & Andy for executing so well. The secret i
items.abstract_or_text: Seeing a hype wave around GEN-1.5, and rightfully so. Lots of respect to Pete & Andy for executing so well. The secret is in the naturally repetitive motions in human-collected data. There're 2 main sources for such repetitions: (1) Symmetric patterns. Sorting, tidying, and assembling almost never finish in one motion. Open any assembly manual from IKEA, and you find most objects symmetrical. You drive one bolt, then its twin, then the next pair. Every {bolt A, bolt B} pair is a natural continuation in context, and the second instance is a free training signal that imitates the first ("prompt"). (2) Recovery. Humans drop things all the time, but we pick them up so fast, we don’t even notice. That reflex to fix is half of our physical competence. The key insight is to keep the failed first half instead of trimming it away. If the model consumes the full arc, fumble, catch, continue, then recovery shows up organically at test time. It's funny that in-context improvement results from *NOT* over-sanitizing your data. The other critical ingredient is UMI. I've been saying for a while that teleop will not last, and GEN-1.5 is driving the final nail in the coffin. UMI is essentially a human wearing the robot gripper to collect data directly (human → data). Teleop inserts a layer of separation: human → VR/skeletal device → robot → data, which bleeds out all the human "physical intuition". The subtle sleight of hand we perform constantly with objects, the micro-adjustments, the feel of a part snapping into place, is nearly impossible to capture when you can't feel the environment directly. Once you have enough data, many behaviors can actually be zero-shot. For example, you don't even need finetuning to pick up a novel object. The model "just knows" what to do given a similar scene in the training distribution. Whether in-context learning truly works or not also depends on how far away the test is from training. Currently, the demos are still a bit too simple to conclude. I'm cautiously optimistic. Still, it's a great day in robotics.
items.summary_zh: Jim Fan 对 GEN-1.5 的训练数据提出解释：人类采集数据中的对称重复动作和“失误—恢复”片段可形成自然的上下文学习信号；他也认为 UMI 比遥操作更能保留物理交互中的细微直觉。作者同时明确表示，目前演示仍较简单，尚不足以断言上下文学习已经成立。编辑认为，这是一则包含机制假设和保留意见的研究者工程解读。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把机器人基础模型的效果讨论从展示结果推进到数据采集、失败样本保留和训练分布距离等可操作问题。
items.abstract_zh: 我看到围绕 GEN-1.5 出现了一波炒作，而且是有道理的。非常尊敬 Pete 和 Andy 的出色执行。关键在于人类采集数据中天然重复的动作。这类重复主要有两种来源：（1）对称模式。整理、归位和装配几乎从不会在一个动作中完成。打开任何一本宜家装配说明书，你会发现大多数物体都是对称的。你拧上一颗螺栓，再拧它对应的那颗，然后是下一对。每一对 {螺栓 A，螺栓 B} 都是在上下文中自然延续，第二次出现就是模仿第一次“提示”的免费训练信号。（2）恢复。人会不断掉落物品，但又很快捡起来，以至于自己都不会注意到。修正失误的这种反射动作构成了我们物理能力的一半。关键见解是保留失败的前半段，而不是把它剪掉。如果模型读入完整轨迹——失手、接住、继续——那么恢复能力会在测试时自然出现。有意思的是，上下文内改进来自于不对数据进行过度清洗。另一个关键成分是 UMI。我一直在说遥操作不会长久，而 GEN-1.5 正在为它敲响最后的丧钟。UMI 本质上是人戴着机器人夹爪直接采集数据（人→数据）。遥操作多插入了一层：人→VR/骨骼设备→机器人→数据，这会流失人的“物理直觉”。我们在操作物体时持续进行的细微处理、微调，以及部件卡入到位的触感，在无法感知环境时几乎无法捕捉。只要有足够数据，许多行为实际上可以零样本完成。例如，你甚至不需要微调就能拾取一个新物体。模型只要在训练分布中见过相似场景，“就知道”该怎么做。上下文学习是否真的有效，也取决于测试与训练相距多远。目前演示仍然有些过于简单，尚不足以下结论。我谨慎乐观。尽管如此，机器人领域今天仍是美好的一天。
items.author_line: Jim Fan

items.title: @AnthropicAI：Many drugs work by binding to a specific target in the body and blocking or changing what it does. An important first st
items.abstract_or_text: Many drugs work by binding to a specific target in the body and blocking or changing what it does. An important first step in the drug development process is designing a molecule that can bind tightly to its target. Traditionally, that's meant weeks or months of expert work per target, sifting through a large number of candidates to identify the few that work. We wanted to test if Claude could successfully design novel protein binders from scratch (also called de novo design). With a protein design prompt written by a human expert, Claude autonomously designed protein binders against 14 out of 15 targets. We then worked with Adaptyv Bio and Twist Bioscience, who independently built and tested the proteins Claude designed.

items.abstract_or_text: Do LLMs know when they have enough information to answer, and what to ask a human when they don’t? @_yepeng We spend a lot of time developing agents that can answer the questions we ask them. But the reverse direction gets much less attention: when the prompt does not contain enough information, can a model recognize what is missing and ask for it? Paper: https://t.co/xlWmIwZ4Mt Project: https://t.co/tY06kTBsyp For agents that interact with humans, biological systems, or clinical workflows, we need to evaluate not only whether they can answer questions, but also whether they know what they need to know before answering. (1) Consider an agent evaluating a patient with pelvic pain. The duration of the pain determines which diagnostic pathway applies, so until the agent asks about it, no downstream symptom or test is clearly relevant. (2) Now consider an agent reasoning about a gene regulatory network, where the outcome depends on the unknown states of several genes. Acquiring one of them can leave several outcomes possible, so the agent must identify the full set that determines the outcome. Both cases raise the same three questions. Does the model recognize that information is missing? Does it identify which information it needs? Does it know when it has enough to answer?
items.summary_zh: Marinka Zitnik 提出，面向人类、生物系统或临床流程的代理，除回答能力外，还应评估其能否识别信息缺失、确定所需信息并判断何时信息已足够。帖文以骨盆疼痛分诊和基因调控网络为例说明这一问题。编辑认为，这把“会回答”扩展为“知道该问什么”的可评测问题。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在高不确定性的人机协作任务中，主动澄清能力直接影响代理是否会在信息不足时作出过早结论。
items.abstract_zh: LLM 是否知道自己何时已经拥有足够信息来回答，以及在没有足够信息时该向人类问什么？我们花了很多时间开发能够回答我们所提问题的代理。但反方向受到的关注少得多：当提示中没有包含足够信息时，模型能否识别缺失了什么并提出询问？论文：https://t.co/xlWmIwZ4Mt 项目：https://t.co/tY06kTBsyp 对于与人类、生物系统或临床工作流交互的代理，我们不仅需要评估它们能否回答问题，还需要评估它们在回答前是否知道自己需要知道什么。（1）设想一个正在评估骨盆疼痛患者的代理。疼痛持续时间决定应采取哪条诊断路径，所以在代理问出这个问题之前，任何后续症状或检查都没有明确相关性。（2）再设想一个推理基因调控网络的代理，其结果取决于若干基因的未知状态。获取其中一个状态后，仍可能有多种结果，因此代理必须识别决定结果的完整状态集合。两种情形都提出同样三个问题：模型是否识别到信息缺失？它是否识别出自己需要哪些信息？它是否知道何时拥有足够信息来回答？

items.summary_zh: langchain-ai/langchain 的 langchain-core==1.6.0 引入标准模型异常类型、惰性导入 transformers，并修复严格工具 schema、序列化和 Windows 可移植性问题。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 依赖 LangChain 工具调用、严格 schema 或跨平台 CI 的应用可获得更清晰的异常语义和更可靠的序列化；惰性导入 `transformers` 可降低未使用该依赖时的启动负担。
items.abstract_zh: `langchain-core==1.6.0` 新增标准模型异常类型，并改为惰性导入 `transformers`。该版本修复 `StructuredTool._injected_args_keys` 的延后注解解析、`RunnablePick` 反序列化、`convert_to_openai_function` 对 callable 与非字典 mapping 的处理，以及 mustache 模板中非字典 Mapping 值的接受。严格工具 schema 现在要求所有嵌套属性，并在序列化时无法解析前向引用会立即报错；同时修复链组在 `BaseException` 时的完成处理，以及 Windows 上子进程和临时文件测试的可移植性。
